threads.body: Why do you need to `null` this? Won't it create a race where `ReceiveFuture` is cancelled and original future is completed at the same time and `setFuture` gets called with `null`?

replies.body:
The callbacks capture the constructor parameter, so clearing the instance field does not affect the reference passed to setFuture. I've renamed the parameter to sourceFuture and added a comment to make this distinction explicit.

I'd keep the cleanup because the CompletableFuture adapter retains ReceiveFuture. In this race, the original future already holds received messages while the wrapper is cancelled. Clearing the field allows the original future and those messages to be released after the completion callback finishes, even if the caller retains the cancelled wrapper.

threads.body: could you add a comment why `setFuture` is necessary. I guess it propagates the value from the original future to `ReceiveFuture`?
